comparison.objective: Join chain ends with a connecting link and retaining plate; candidate removes a retained electrical contact.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests multi-hole alignment, stem insertion, keeper alignment, and final seating. Candidate tests guided blade insertion, simultaneous tang depression, and bimanual extraction.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both chain holes seated on stems, keeper slots engaged, assembly in a cradle, hands released, and no invalid state. Candidate requires the selected terminal out and all other terminals still fully retained without damage.
comparison.reason: Despite both involving retainers, PR tests assembly and addition of retention, while the candidate tests selective internal release and extraction.
